critical_sources.title: Valerian for insomnia: a systematic review of randomized clinical trials
European Union herbal monograph on Valeriana officinalis L., radix
critical_sources.authors: European Medicines Agency, Committee on Herbal Medicinal Products (HMPC)

precedence_definition: Both references are applicable; SYSTEMATIC_REVIEW outranks EMA_HMPC for INDICATION_EVIDENCE under the existing repository hierarchy.
scope_note: No dose or preparation is invented. The benchmark question is narrowed to insomnia, the overlap between the systematic-review question and EMA sleep-disorder use.
